y1: People brought children to Jesus so He could lay His hands on them and pray. But the disciples stopped them, saying, 'Jesus is busy, do not disturb Him!'
y2: Jesus said, 'Let the children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.' Then He laid His hands on the children and gave them a blessing.
y4: A young man came and asked, 'Teacher, what good thing must I do to get eternal life?' Jesus told him to keep the commandments. The young man said, 'I have kept all of them.'
y5: Jesus said, 'Go, sell your wealth, give to the poor, and come, follow me.' Because the young man had a lot of wealth, he went away sad.
y6: The camel and the eye of a needle
y7: Jesus said, 'It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.'
y8: The disciples were amazed and asked, 'Who then can be saved?' Jesus answered, 'With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.'
y10: Peter said, 'We have left everything and followed You.'
y11: Jesus promised, 'Everyone who has left houses, family, or lands for my name's sake will receive a hundred times as much, and will inherit eternal life. Many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.'
verse: “Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.”
prayer: Jesus, thank You for not hindering the children, but hugging and blessing them. I am glad that I can come to You anytime. Help me not to love other things more, like the rich young man did, but to love You more than anything else. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: blessing. Wishing for God to give good things. Jesus gave the children a blessing.
d1: young man. A young person growing into an adult. The rich young man came to Jesus.
d2: wealth. The money, houses, and things we own. The young man had a lot of wealth.
d3: camel. A very large animal that lives in the desert. Can a camel go through the eye of a needle?
d4: eye of a needle. The very small hole in a needle where the thread goes through. The eye of a needle is very small.
